title: SMOK X-Priv Solo Vape Kit
description: With the Smok X-Priv Solo Kit, sub-ohm vapers can experience one of the most compact and portable sub-ohm kits ever made, while enjoying a powerful and versatile vaping experience all wrapped in a sleek and ergonomic design. Powered by a single 18650 battery (sold separately) and activated by a tactile large side fire key, the X-Priv Solo delivers up to 80W of power, making it especially suited for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping styles with high-VG e-liquids. One of the standout features of the X-Priv Solo is its 2.0" touch screen, offering a vibrant, intuitive interface that allows users to switch between vaping modes, adjust wattage, and customise themes with ease. The dual-screen display provides useful information such as wattage, resistance, puff count, and battery life at a glance. Several safety protections are provided by the Smok’s latest cutting-edge chipset, including short-circuit, over-heating, and overtime protections The device also includes a handy vibration reminder, notifying you of any necessary adjustments or warnings. This high-performance kit includes the Smok TF-D Subtank, which features a top-fill system for easy refills and a 2ml capacity. The tank's top airflow control system ensures smooth and precise adjustments for your preferred draw, while the leak-resistant design keeps the mess to a minimum. The Smok D-Coils, available in resistances of 0.15ohm, 0.23ohm, and 0.4ohm, are designed to deliver rich flavours and dense clouds, making this kit ideal for vapers who enjoy high-VG e-liquids. Built for those who appreciate both style, power and portability, the Smok X-Priv Solo is available in a range of luxurious finishes, including Black Shell, White Shell, Pale Blue, Silver Lines, Purple, and Pink. To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping. Discover our vape liquid uk range and enjoy flavours that match this kit effortlessly.
